proposal.name: brace-expansion
proposal.rationale: The SBOM declares brace-expansion@1.1.21 with range ^1.1.0. E1 confirms the package exists in npm and 1.1.21 is among the latest versions. E2 lists versions satisfying ^1.1.0 before the SBOM timestamp (2026-11-12), with 1.1.21 having the highest prior probability (0.378). The declared version is confirmed as the most likely exact version.
